remarks: Live in the heart of historic SONO! This updated and cozy 1 bedroom condo is located in a well-managed building near the waterside of Washington Street. The unit features a spacious living room with fireplace, separate office, dining area and galley kitchen with marble countertops. Freshly painted with a renovated bathroom. New hot water heater, Washer/Dryer in unit, central air, hardwood floors and crown moldings, ample closet space. An ideal setup for anyone working from home. Easy commute to NYC and nearby towns with convenient access to 95 and Merritt Parkway. Public and private parking readily available. 1 garage space can be included for $80 per month. Walk to the water, train, Maritime Aquarium, parks, great restaurants and shops.
